scripts.build: bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-core' build && bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-lang' build && bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-wql' build && bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-engine' build && bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-ui' build && bun run --filter '@bitcobblers/wod-wiki-storybook' build
scripts.pack:all: mkdir -p tarballs && for pkg in packages/*; do if [ -f "$pkg/package.json" ]; then (cd "$pkg" && npm pack --pack-destination ../../tarballs); fi; done
